PROP-e5782b58-inv-013.text: Permission_level must only be modifiable by admin users through admin user management endpoint.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-013.assertion: forall UPDATE members.users SET is_admin: caller.is_admin == true AND via admin endpoint only

locations.note: Only function that modifies is_admin in the codebase. Verifies caller is_admin at lines 503-506 before updating. Only callable as a Server Action from authenticated dashboard routes.
Used in other admin server actions (updateMemberAdmin, etc.) but toggleAdminStatus has its own inline admin check.
